channel_load_failed: This channel could not be opened
description_slack_advanced: The rest of the Slack attachment. Every box here is optional.
help_channel_name_immutable: Renaming is blocked while alert rules and routing policies still reference a channel by name.
tooltip_webhook_url: The URL of the webhook to send alerts to. Learn more about webhook integration in the docs [here](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/webhook/). Integrates with [Incident.io](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/incident-io/), [Rootly](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/rootly/), [Zenduty](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/zenduty/) and [more](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/webhook/#my-incident-management-tool-is-not-listed-can-i-still-integrate).
tooltip_slack_url: The URL of the slack [incoming webhook](https://docs.slack.dev/messaging/sending-messages-using-incoming-webhooks/) to send alerts to. Learn more about slack integration in the docs [here](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/slack/).
tooltip_pager_routing_key: Learn how to obtain the routing key from your PagerDuty account [here](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/pagerduty/#obtaining-integration-or-routing-key).
tooltip_opsgenie_api_key: Learn how to obtain the API key from your OpsGenie account [here](https://support.atlassian.com/opsgenie/docs/integrate-opsgenie-with-prometheus/).
tooltip_email_to: Enter email addresses separated by commas.
tooltip_ms_teams_url: The URL of the Microsoft Teams [webhook](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/create-incoming-webhooks-with-workflows-for-microsoft-teams-8ae491c7-0394-4861-ba59-055e33f75498) to send alerts to. Learn more about Microsoft Teams integration in the docs [here](https://signoz.io/docs/alerts-management/notification-channel/ms-teams/).
tooltip_google_chat_url: The URL of the Google Chat space [incoming webhook](https://developers.google.com/workspace/chat/quickstart/webhooks) to send alerts to.
tooltip_jira_site: Your Jira Cloud base URL, e.g. https://your-domain.atlassian.net, or a proxy in front of it.
jira_required_fields: Site URL, email, API token, project and issue type are required
jira_service_account_tip: Recommended: use a Jira service account so alerts aren't reported under a personal name and the channel keeps working when someone leaves.
help_jira_email: The Atlassian account email used for authentication.
help_jira_api_token: Create one at id.atlassian.com under Security → API tokens.
help_jira_issue_type: An issue type that exists in the project, e.g. Task, Bug or Incident.
help_jira_summary: Template for the Jira issue title.
help_jira_description: Template for the issue description. Rendered as rich text with a status panel and links back to SigNoz.
placeholder_jira_priority: Leave empty to use the project default
help_jira_priority: Must match a priority in the project's scheme, e.g. High.
placeholder_jira_labels: Type a label and press Enter
help_jira_labels: signoz and a deduplication label are added automatically.
help_jira_resolve_transition: When the alert resolves, SigNoz moves the Jira issue to a "Done" status via a workflow transition. This is auto-detected — leave it empty unless your project has more than one "Done" transition (e.g. Done vs. Won't Do) and you want to force a specific one by name.
help_jira_reopen_transition: When a resolved alert fires again (within the reopen window), SigNoz moves the issue back out of "Done" to an active status via a workflow transition. This is auto-detected — leave it empty unless you want to force a specific one by name (e.g. To Do or Reopen).
help_jira_wont_fix_resolution: If the issue was resolved with this resolution (e.g. Won't Do), SigNoz won't reopen it when the alert fires again; a new issue is created instead. Leave empty to always reopen.
help_jira_reopen_duration: If a resolved alert fires again within this window, the same ticket is reopened; after the window, a re-fire opens a new ticket instead. Default: 3d.
tooltip_jira_reopen_duration: Accepted units: m (minutes), h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), y (years) — e.g. 30m, 72h or 3d. Minimum 1m.
jira_reopen_duration_invalid: Reopen window must be a duration like 30m, 72h or 3d (minimum 1m)
jsmops_tip: Create an API integration on your JSM team's Operations page and paste its key below.
help_jsmops_api_key: The JSM Ops integration API key, from your team's Operations → Integrations → API. Make sure the integration is turned on.
help_jsmops_message: Template for the alert title. Truncated to 130 characters.
help_jsmops_description: Template for the alert description. Rendered as rich text; kept under 15,000 characters.
help_jsmops_priority: Template resolving to one of P1–P5. Leave as-is to map from alert severity.
placeholder_jsmops_tags: Type a tag and press Enter
incidentio_tip: Create an HTTP alert source in incident.io (On-call → Alert routing → Sources) and paste its URL and token below.
help_incidentio_url: The alert events URL from the source's setup page, e.g. https://api.incident.io/v2/alert_events/http/<source_config_id>.
help_incidentio_token: The alert source's secret token, from the same setup page.
help_incidentio_title: Template for the alert title. Kept stable while the alert fires — incident.io ignores content updates on repeat events.
help_incidentio_description: Template for the alert description. Markdown, rendered natively by incident.io.
incidentio_required_fields: Alert source URL and token are required
incidentio_token_bearer_prefix: Paste the token only, without the Bearer prefix
incidentio_token_whitespace: Remove the spaces around the token
help_incidentio_metadata: Key-value pairs added to every alert's metadata, on top of the alert's labels (these win on a key clash). Values may use templates, e.g. {{ .CommonLabels.severity }}.
help_slack_color: good, warning, danger, or a hex value like #439FE0. Templates are allowed.
help_slack_fallback: Plain text shown where the attachment cannot render, such as push notifications
help_slack_fields: Extra entries rendered as a table inside the attachment
slack_field_value_required: Enter a value for this field
help_slack_actions: Buttons rendered under the attachment. A button with a URL links out.
slack_action_url_or_name_required: Enter a URL or a name for this button
help_email_to: Email address(es) to send alerts to (comma separated)
help_pager_client: Shows up as event source in Pagerduty
help_pager_client_url: Shows up as event source link in Pagerduty
help_pager_details: Specify a key-value format (must be a valid json)
help_pager_group: A cluster or grouping of sources
help_pager_component: The part or component of the affected system that is broke
help_pager_severity: Severity of the incident, must be one of: must be one of the following: 'critical', 'warning', 'error' or 'info'
help_webhook_bearer_token: Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
help_pager_description: Shows up as description in pagerduty
help_opsgenie_message: Shows up as message in opsgenie
help_opsgenie_description: Shows up as description in opsgenie
channel_test_done: An alert has been sent to this channel
channel_test_failed: Failed to send a test message to this channel, please confirm that the parameters are set correctly
channel_test_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred while sending a message to this channel, please try again
routing_key_required: Routing Key is mandatory for creating pagerduty channel
pager_details_invalid_json: Enter valid JSON, or clear the box to send no details
slack_channel_help: Specify channel or user, use #channel-name, @username (has to be all lowercase, no whitespace)
tooltip_send_resolved: Also notify this channel when an alert stops firing.
tooltip_channel_type: Where the alert is delivered. It cannot be changed once the channel is saved.
discard_changes_body: This form has unsaved changes. If you leave now, they are gone and the channel stays as it is.
tooltip_slack_field_title: The bold label Slack shows above the value, for example Severity.
tooltip_slack_field_value: What Slack shows under the title. Templates are allowed, so `{{ .CommonLabels.severity }}` fills in from the alert.
tooltip_slack_fields: Extra entries Slack renders as a small table inside the alert attachment.
tooltip_slack_actions: Buttons Slack renders under the attachment. A button with a URL links out; the rest are for a Slack app to handle.
tooltip_slack_action_url: Where the button sends the reader. Leave empty for a button a Slack app handles instead.
tooltip_slack_action_name: Identifies the button to a Slack app. Not needed for a button that only links out.
tooltip_slack_action_value: Sent to a Slack app along with the name, so one app can tell its buttons apart.
tooltip_slack_action_style: default, primary or danger. Slack colours the button accordingly.
tooltip_slack_action_confirm: Text for a confirmation prompt shown before the action runs. Leave empty for no prompt.
bot_token_required: Bot token is mandatory for creating a telegram channel
chat_id_required: Chat ID is mandatory for creating a telegram channel
telegram_tip: Create a bot with @BotFather, add it to the chat, then paste its token and the chat's numeric id below.
tooltip_telegram_bot_token: The token BotFather returns, in the form 123456789:AA...
tooltip_telegram_chat_id: The numeric chat the bot posts to, negative for groups and channels. Telegram's @username form is not accepted.
tooltip_telegram_message_thread_id: Posts into one message thread of a forum group. Leave empty to post in the group itself.
tooltip_telegram_title: Sent in bold above the message. Telegram HTML, so interpolated values are escaped.
tooltip_telegram_message: Template for the message body. Telegram HTML, so interpolated values are escaped.
tooltip_telegram_api_url: Point at a self-hosted Bot API server. Leave empty to use Telegram's.
tooltip_telegram_disable_notifications: Delivers without a sound or vibration on the recipients' devices.
